{#- Macros shared by the Cache and Clients pages (both built by one page builder; roxy/admin/pages/cache.py and roxy/admin/pages/clients.py). What `reset_dialog(r, refresh=..., on_success=...)`: the confirm dialog of a plan 6.8 data reset (a metric family such as `cache_stats` or `activity`, or one client). It posts JSON to `POST /admin/api/v1/data/resets` with the scope, the preview digest the server computed for exactly that scope (`data.build_plan(...).digest`), a reason and, when the plan asks for one, the typed phrase (sent as `confirm`, the API checks it again). When it opens, the page script asks `POST /data/resets/preview` for the exact row counts and shows the API's own summary. `fill_note()`: the line a shared confirm dialog shows its target in (the page script writes it as text). `timeline(steps)`: v1's "what happens to one request" steps (strong words and state badges, all plain text). Why A reset cannot be undone, so it gets a deliberate dialog with plain-language consequences and, for a whole family, the typed phrase (plan 6.8, 14.5); the API stays the one place that validates and audits it.
